correctness.rationale: For a labelled F_q-linear code of diameter at most three, a word nonzero at each pivot bounds rank by three. Uniform words have mean weight s(q-1)/q, so support is at most four, at most three for q>=5; the mean obstruction is even strict for nonzero codes because the zero word has weight zero, excluding s=4 for q=4. For support four, rank one is impossible, and rank three is a hyperplane with check-vector support t=2,3 or 4. Nonzero check-coordinate entries can be chosen in opposite pairs for even t and to form a nonzero triple summing to zero for t=3 (choose two nonzero entries with nonzero sum, possible for q>=3); arbitrary other entries give a weight-four word. For rank two, the four nonzero columns must represent all projective directions, since otherwise there is a row direction vanishing on none of them. In the ternary case each direction then occurs once, all words other than zero have weight three, and ordered column choices divided by GL_2(3) give 24*16/48=8. For s<=3 all support subspaces are valid, so one counts full-support lines up to scalar, planes by removing the three coordinate planes in length three, and full coordinate spaces in their respective ranks. The exact polynomial, totals, leading coefficients, and n=0 follow. Independent replay: python3 -B /workspace/reproductions/anticodes.py constructs distinct word-set subspaces by extensions, including all ranks, and directly checks every coefficient at (q,n)=(3,5),(4,4),(5,4) after scanning 2664, 529 and 1120 subspaces; it gives respectively 226, 141 and 215 qualifying subspaces and 40 rank-two support-four codes in the first case. The frozen verify.py prints a full support/rank tally but only asserts the total and the exceptional coefficient, not all coefficients as the verification prose claims; the independent finite check compares them individually. The proof, not a finite test, establishes the full range.

evidence: AntiGriesmer gives n <= sum_i floor(3/q^i) for any full-support code here. This excludes support four for all ranks when q>=4, not just rank two; q=3 permits support four in the bound from rank two onward.

Together with the simplex example, the prior support results settle the growth degrees. The diameter-four Resultary census explicitly admits all subspaces in length four, so its support-four counts include codes excluded here.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The strong support results preempt the claimed field-size transition as an originality argument. Their bounds leave the ternary rank-three obstruction and labelled rank-two count to be established, and the at-most-four enumeration cannot be specialized by changing an ambient dimension to impose at most three.
